bills.sql: SELECT id, supplier, period, amount, status FROM bills WHERE (:status IS NULL OR status = :status) ORDER BY period DESC, id DESC

month_total.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM bills WHERE substr(period, 1, 7) = substr(:today, 1, 7)

unpaid_total.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM bills WHERE status = 'unpaid'

unpaid_count.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bills WHERE status = 'unpaid'

monthly_totals.sql: SELECT substr(period, 1, 7) AS month, SUM(amount) AS total FROM bills GROUP BY month ORDER BY month DESC LIMIT 12

add_bill.sql: INSERT INTO bills(supplier, period, amount, status) VALUES (:supplier, :period, :amount, :status)
add_bill.label: Add a bill

mark_paid.sql: UPDATE bills SET status = 'paid' WHERE id = :id
mark_paid.label: Mark the bill as paid
